rationale: All four service lines on claim PA22957514 were denied with group code OA / CARC 18 (exact duplicate claim/service). The MOA remark N111 on the claim level confirms "no appeal right except duplicate claim/service issue." Per denial-lifecycle.md §7 and §11, Medicare exact-duplicate edits (OA-18) are hard-coded and MACs cannot override them; the correct recourse if the provider believes the duplicate finding is wrong is a Telephone Reopening with Novitas — NOT a new claim submission and NOT a standard appeal. Resubmitting the same claim would generate a fresh OA-18 denial and risk program-integrity scrutiny. The 277CA shows the claim was accepted for adjudication (A2/status 20), so this is a true denial, not an unprocessable return. The chart note documents a legitimate two-block physical therapy session (two bouts each of 97140 and 97110 on 2026-07-05), which is clinically supportable, but the payer's system flagged this claim as a duplicate — most likely because a prior claim for the same DOS/member/provider combination was already on file and adjudicated. The provider must call Novitas Provider Services (800-555-1234) and request a Telephone Reopening to: (1) identify the controlling claim number that triggered the duplicate edit; (2) confirm whether that prior claim was paid, denied, or is still in process; and (3) resolve the conflict through the reopening channel if no prior adjudication exists. No new claim or formal appeal should be filed.
